games.shortDescription: «Grief like a stray dog» is a meditation on war, community and human fate
games.longDescription:
An isolated village during the war. Men leave one by one, along the winding forest path painted crimson by distant fires, and do not return. Young Nadia becomes a part-time postwoman filling in for her sick mother. She is now a messenger of hope and of trouble.

«Grief like a stray dog» is a short interactive play about a young postwoman in a tight-knit rural community. In the outside world, WW2 rages at its apex. Nadia is thirteen. She delivers papers, letters. And death notifications to families of those killed in action.

Nadia’s character is based on the author’s grandmother. Inspired by tales of a childhood spent in a village near Rzhev, not far from one of the most brutal battlefields of the Eastern Front, most of the character arcs and plot points are based on war stories told by older relatives and locals; many letters are real.

The main visual inspirations for the game were kid’s drawings, neo-expressionism, Russian lubok art and Soviet book illustration

«Grief like a stray dog» is a meditation on war, community and human fate — part documentary, part Russian folk tale.

Features:
- A visual novel with elements of an adventure game.
- A rich and touching story based on memories and Russian folk tales.
- Author's 2D graphics.
- Disturbing and unusual soundtrack.
- Capacious and authentic dialogues.
- Duration: 60-80 minutes.
- A village populated by picturesque characters.

games.shortDescription: An atmospheric platformer with puzzle elements and split screen
games.longDescription:
Hand In Hand is a 2D split screen puzzle platformer, where the player can control two characters at once, or two players can play in co-op mode on one device.

A TOUCHING STORY
Two soulmates live in a fairytale world. But when evil came to their world, they lost each other. Now both of them need to head towards each other, facing many difficulties and dangers along the way. And only by finding a fragile connection between one another and going hand in hand will they be able to defeat evil and meet again. It's a story about how we can help one another even when you're apart, and be far from one another even when you're nearby. It's a story about the importance of relationships and mutual support. But every story has an even deeper meaning...

SPLIT SCREEN
The game works in splitscreen mode, with one character on each screen in their respective locations. The game has two modes. The first is single-player mode, where one player simultaneously controls both characters with one joystick. In this mode, the player must demonstrate sophisticated controller skills. The second is local co-op mode, where two players control the characters using two joysticks. Here, both players control their respective characters. Each mode has its advantages. Single-player mode requires you to show great dexterity and reaction speed, and co-op mode allows you to feel the joy of playing the game with your family or friend. Try both game modes, we hope you'll like it and enjoy completing it.

THE CHARACTERS INTERACT WITH AND HELP EACH OTHER
Each character has their own part of the level in a common location. However, some parts of the level are interconnected. This means that the characters can interact and help each other complete the level. Characters can move keys and objects from one part of the screen to another, and most puzzles are need to be solved by both characters working together, connecting parts of the screen and solving puzzles together.

EPIC BOSSES
The game has epic boss battles. Each boss represents the world of shadows that has invaded this fairytale forest and wants to plunge all the inhabitants of this fairytale world into the horror of eternal darkness. Our brave heroes, Lina and Minho, must defeat each of the bosses so that peace and prosperity will once again reign in the fairy forest. Boss battles take place without splitscreen, and are designed to be played by just one of the characters, so each character must defeat their evil shadow bosses.

PUZZLES
On their way through the collapsing fairy-tale world, the characters will constantly encounter various puzzles like closed doors, laser beams with reflectors, ancient mechanisms and ruins, labyrinths, and caves full of dangers. Our heroes will be able to overcome all difficulties, but each will have to make every effort to pass these trials and help their companion.

games.shortDescription: Haneda Girl is an action-platformer with brutal, high-octane gameplay.
games.longDescription:
Welcome to Data Empire: Pilot Haneda!

ALERT! Data Empire is under attack from the terrifying Hackernauts!

Join Chichi Wakaba (aka Haneda Girl) and help her defend Data Empire from this chaotic invasion.
Dive into an action-packed adventure with an amazing game feel, alongside M.O.T.H.E.R., Haneda Girl’s tactical combat mecha.

A slick and precise 2D action platformer

Haneda Girl is a stylish 2D action platformer where you can instantly swap between two characters to deal with threats in the smartest, fastest way possible.
Every encounter can be tackled differently — be inventive!
From speedrunners to casual players, this game is made for EVERYONE.

“Learn from your mistakes”

Replayability is at the heart of the experience.
But don’t stress! Short runs, tight controls and a thrilling game feel will make every pixel of this challenging adventure worth it.

“The challenge isn’t the path itself, but how you make your way through it.”

Blades or bullets: play it safe with M.O.T.H.E.R., or go full throttle with Haneda (insta-kill mode).
Just remember:

“You can go faster alone, but further together.”

Instructions:

Cautious and defensive → use M.O.T.H.E.R.

Sometimes daring → swap between M.O.T.H.E.R. and Haneda

Always fearless → Haneda Girl, no hesitation!

Rank up and collect medallions!

Find hidden lore across Data Empire by collecting medallions and unlock new ballistic weapons for the mecha M.O.T.H.E.R.
New weapons = new tactical advantages.

Story

Chichi Wakaba is the best Haneda Girl player at Mr. Hinata’s coffee shop arcade.
After school, when homework’s light, she pops by to save Data Empire once again.
She’s so good that Professor Nakamura, the game’s creator, chooses her to enter the game and become a real Haneda Girl pilot.
With her tactical combat mecha M.O.T.H.E.R., she takes on the Hackernauts, the biggest threat Data Empire has ever faced.

Will you help her defeat these pesky invaders once and for all, and bring lasting peace to Data Empire?

Sign up and fight evil after school!

A unique experience

A lighthearted yet powerful story backed by a banging techno soundtrack and fast, dopamine-charged gameplay sessions — pure fun guaranteed.

“In a world full of cortisol, be the dopamine.”
